issues.description: Class name 'AwscsdkutilsConan' does not strictly PascalCase each hyphen-separated segment of the software name. An ideal form would be 'AwsCSdkutilsConan' (capitalizing 'aws', 'c', 'sdkutils' as separate words). However, the current naming strips hyphens and capitalizes only the first letter, which is a widely accepted convention in Conan recipes and does not affect functionality.
issues.recommendation: Consider renaming to 'AwsCSdkutilsConan' for stricter PascalCase compliance, but this is non-blocking.

issues.description: The 'url' attribute is set to the upstream homepage (https://github.com/awslabs/aws-c-sdkutils), identical to 'homepage'. In Conan convention, 'url' typically points to the recipe's own repository. Since this recipe lives in the OpenDesk archives directory (not the upstream repo), 'url' could point to the OpenDesk recipe location. This is a minor convention deviation common in practice and does not affect build correctness.
issues.recommendation: Optional: set 'url' to the OpenDesk recipe repository if applicable. Non-blocking.

issues.description: Test package uses the 'generators = "CMakeDeps", "CMakeToolchain"' class attribute shorthand instead of a 'generate()' method. While valid in Conan 2.x, the explicit 'generate()' method with CMakeToolchain/CMakeDeps instances is the recommended approach for consistency with the main conanfile.py. No custom configuration is needed here so the shorthand is acceptable.
issues.recommendation: Optional: migrate to explicit generate() method for consistency. Non-blocking.

issues.description: Version manifest uses 'software' field name instead of 'name' as shown in the code-style rule 14 example. The rule example shows 'name: zlib' but this manifest uses 'software: "aws-c-sdkutils"'. Both are understandable but the field name differs from the documented convention.
issues.recommendation: Optional: align field name to 'name' if the manifest schema allows. Non-blocking.
